Hi Stuart,
I must object to your misrepresentations to my friends and colleagues. Just to be clear in the over ten years
that I've known you, I have not done anything malicious toward you or TSC. In my last correspondence
from you, you asked me for suggestions which I offered. Previous to that, I directed all speaking and
workshop requests that I received to you. I do not know how this lead to your accusing "me and my friends"
of "ruining it" or of running a "scam."
I first met Wendy in 2009 when she came to the Hong Kong Conference that I hosted. Two years ago, she
asked me to fly up to Shanghai to see her and told me that she'd like to support my organizing a
consciousness event in China for the next 10 years. Her motivation was personal (Crystal Globe's main
business isn't events, but cultural property development). She learned a lot from the Hong Kong event and
felt that China and Asia should develop in this area.
I floated the idea of hosting TSC in Shanghai for 2017 as a start and told her that I would explore that
possibility. This was just as the Helsinki event was starting. If you recall, I showed up in Helsinki on the
second to last day and floated the idea to you (you were leaning toward Amsterdam at the time if you recall)
and you agreed to come out for a visit. I flew up to Shanghai to accompany you on that visit. During the
visit, you agreed to allow us to host TSC and then Wendy surprised both of us by floating the offer to provide
financing as an investment. You may recall the humour between us at the time as it was unclear the amount
she was offering (off by a factor of 10). You seemed very happy at the time, and I helped to draft the MOU.
In our discussions in Shanghai, you shared with me your desire to "retire" from anaesthesiology and do
consciousness related work full-time. We talked about the additional income you would need to make that
happen and we agreed to explore sustainable revenue models together.
Since the signing of the MOU, I have not been involved in any of the discussions. During TSC last year in
Tucson, I used some ofmy grant funding to bring a team over to get a sense of the Conference so that they
could help out. We began meeting in the Fall to build a team to help plan TSC activities, including a pre-

EFTA01051221

 conference workshop and a post-conference road-trip to Beijing for the ASSC Conference. I had the team
Skype with Stu, the team put a plan together and made preparations (see attached). Note, all of this has been
volunteer work. In an effort to explore more funding opportunities and possible revenue streams, I
introduced Stuart to a benefactor of mine in New York and also had him meet with another friend that was
working to develop an agency related to consciousness. The idea behind these introductions was to line up
revenue streams for Stuart.
When I found out you were going to be in Shanghai again to give talks, I flew up there to talk about the
conference and to show you, Betsy, James, and Kelly around. I brought Robert and Molly along to
understand the venue and help with planning, etc. When I got the original mail from Yi Fa about the
Buddhism and Technology Conference, I forwarded the mail to both Wendy and Stuart. When I found out
that Yi Fa was going to be in Shanghai for a day on her way to Antarctica, I flew up to meet with her and
Wendy at the airport. Because they couldn't get a permit in Beijing to hold the event there, they moved their
event to Shanghai. I talked to Jamie who was overseeing their programming and asked him for a list of
people he felt were relevant to their event. He (not under my instruction) sent another list to Stuart and he
blew up at me. It was at this point in time, that I backed away from anything happening with the
Conference. I assumed that Wendy was working directly with Stuart.
Two weeks ago, I embarked on an India tour and spoke in Agra and got to meet their Supreme Leader.
Vishal directed me to people that I was to personally invite to Shanghai and did so on behalf of the
Conference. I also gave talks in Chandigarh, Delhi, and Mumbai and promoted attendance to the Conference
at each place.
Regarding what appears to be this final break, I only became aware of it when I received this message from
Wendy:

This was my introduction to the current "situation." While I have no idea as to how things got so off track
